headline: Profit rebounds sharply year over year, eases sequentially
summary_short: Allstate reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $16.941 billion, up 3.0% y/y but down 2.3% q/q, with net income of $2.457 billion (+312.9% y/y, -35.9% q/q) and diluted EPS of $9.25.
summary_long: Revenue was $16.941B, up 3.0% y/y (down 2.3% q/q) from $17.345B. Net income of $2.457B rose 312.9% y/y off a low $595M base, though down 35.9% q/q from $3.832B. Diluted EPS was $9.25, up 338.4% y/y, down 35.6% q/q. Operating cash flow rose 81.3% y/y to $3.562B. Total cash fell 17.0% y/y to $697M; shareholders' equity rose 43.3% y/y to $31.607B.
